Variants.Content: Sunhouse City is the castle territory in the southern part of the Reach. It is located in an area with sufficient sunshine, suitable for farming, animal husbandry, and the growth of fruit trees. The warmth of the south allows for a longer farming season than in the north, but it also makes ditches, granaries and protection against dry season fires a daily routine. The city relied on nearby manors for its supplies, and roads brought wine, grain, wool and livestock to Highgarden and the coast. The politics of the Reach are often depicted as banquets and flowers, and The City of Sunshine illustrates that behind the flowers there are waterwheels, tax books, and soil.

Entry Sunhouse If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
